proof_body:
by
  intro B Q₁ Q₂ R₁ R₂ hB h₁ h₂ h
  have hQ : Q₁ = Q₂ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hne' : Q₁ - Q₂ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
    have hle : B.degree ≤ (B * (Q₁ - Q₂)).degree := Polynomial.degree_le_mul_left B hne'
    have heq : B * (Q₁ - Q₂) = R₂ - R₁ := by linear_combination h
    have hlt : (R₂ - R₁).degree < B.degree := lt_of_le_of_lt (Polynomial.degree_sub_le _ _) (max_lt h₂ h₁)
    rw [heq] at hle
    exact absurd hlt (not_lt.mpr hle)
  subst hQ
  exact ⟨rfl, add_left_cancel h⟩
target_source: ∀ (B Q₁ Q₂ R₁ R₂ : Polynomial ℝ), B ≠ 0 → R₁.degree < B.degree → R₂.degree < B.degree → B * Q₁ + R₁ = B * Q₂ + R₂ → Q₁ = Q₂ ∧ R₁ = R₂
